gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-gowun-dodum: Ruler-straight and showy, Bruno Ace draws every line at a constant width, leaving its counters open to the outside. Gowun Dodum is the smoother voice, with tube-like strokes.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-gruppo: Gruppo keeps its curve endings well apart from one another, giving a clean, light sans texture. And Bruno Ace earns its keep when set big and short, where its ruler-drawn line shows.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-gudea: Counters that stay open to the outside, drawn in a ruler-straight line, mark Bruno Ace as a display face with real character. Shrink it, though, and that charm fades.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-hanken-grotesk: Wire-bent and wide-channelled, that's Hanken Grotesk's look. Bruno Ace is the one that grabs attention with its lingering, one-character-per-beat rhythm, while the sans-serif body simply stays out of the way.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-host-grotesk: Host Grotesk reads smooth and contemporary, its curves sweeping open instead of curling shut. Bruno Ace's g keeps one unchanging line weight, and that stiff, drawn-by-ruler precision is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-hubot-sans: Bruno Ace draws every line with a ruler's constant width. It leads with expressive display character, while Hubot Sans, with its widely opened e, handles the quieter work of text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ibm-plex-sans-arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic has easily readable open apertures and a friendly, clean feel. But Bruno Ace, with strokes like a bent paperclip, would lose its punch if shrunk down to text size.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devana: Not a hint of brush-style pressure swell appears in Bruno Ace, just a ruler-drawn line and counters that stay open to the outside. Against that rigidity, IBM Plex Sans Devanagari's rope-loose curves feel relaxed.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ibm-plex-sans-hebrew: IBM Plex Sans Hebrew keeps its s and c open and uncrowded, which gives it a modern, approachable feel. Bruno Ace is the showpiece here, with a plain unmodulated outline that stands out in display sizes.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ibm-plex-sans-jp: IBM Plex Sans JP finishes each curve in a clean, open gap, giving it a professional but friendly look. Over a long passage, IBM Plex Sans JP would read smoothly beneath Bruno Ace's unthinning curves.
